title: Mipiti test-result attestation predicate (v1)
description: The predicate of an in-toto Statement with predicateType https://mipiti.io/attestations/test-result/v1. Produced by `mipiti-verify attest-tests`; any producer that emits a conforming statement signed under an identity the verifier is pinned to is accepted. Verification reads the statement and executes nothing.

commit.description: Git commit the run covered. Must equal the commit under verification; an empty value fails.

invocation.description: argv the producer's own test step executed, as recorded by the producer.

outcome.description: passed only when failed == 0, errors == 0 and passed > 0.

totals.description: Must be self-consistent: passed + failed + skipped + errors == total.

selected.description: How many tests the run selected. matched_count must be > 0; a vacuous selection is refused.

file.description: Optional. Repository-relative path of the file the test is defined in, as located in the checkout at attestation time.

definition_sha256.description: Optional. SHA-256 over the test's definition block (decorators through the end of the body; CRLF folded to LF, trailing whitespace stripped per line) when it could be isolated, otherwise over the whole file (see definition_scope). Absent when the test could not be located; absence is 'not resolved', never a match.

definition_scope.description: Optional. What definition_sha256 covers. "symbol": exactly the named definition, isolated by a parser or by an exact keyword-pair block match. "block": a block starting at the first line that matched the name; a same-named definition later in the file is not covered. "file": the whole file, because the definition could not be isolated.

parser.description: Optional. What isolated the definition span: Python's ast, a tree-sitter grammar, the HDL keyword-pair scanner, or the brace / indentation line heuristic. Absent when definition_scope is "file".

reached.description: Optional. Files and lines this test executed, from a coverage report that attributes lines to tests (coverage.py contexts, or one report per test; `attest-tests --coverage`). An empty array is a fact: the run had coverage and the test touched nothing tracked. Absent means nothing was attributed to this test; an aggregate report records suite_reached instead.

suite_reached.description: Optional. Files and lines the whole run executed, from an aggregate coverage report (LCOV, Cobertura, JaCoCo, coverage.py without contexts). Informational: it says what the suite reached, not what this test reached, so it never establishes reach on its own.

mechanism.description: <file>::<symbol> that was disabled for the run.

status.description: The test's outcome with the mechanism disabled. Anything but passed means the test depends on it; error means the pair produced no outcome (see reason when it was not run at all).

reason.description: Optional. Present when the pair was not run (for example the run's total budget was spent first). A reader treats such an entry as no outcome, never as dependence or its absence.

fails_without.description: Optional; present on dependence records (kind = "dependence"). One entry per mechanism the test was run without.

tests.description: One record per test with its own status. A test_attested assertion names one of these exactly and requires its status to be passed; a skipped test is not evidence. Optional per-test fields bind the record to the test's definition (file, definition_sha256, definition_scope), what it reached (reached), and what it fails without (fails_without).

ci.description: Recorded for a reader; never a trust anchor. Trust comes from the signature.

environment.description: Nominated environment variables and their values at run time; null records that a nominated name was unset. Absent when the producer nominated nothing, which cannot satisfy an assertion's env requirement.

kind.description: Optional. Absent for a test-result record. "dependence" marks a record produced by `mipiti-verify attest-dependence`: each test entry's status is the test's outcome with the mechanism named in its fails_without entry disabled. "reach" marks a record produced by `mipiti-verify attest-reach`: each test entry carries the per-test coverage (reached) of a run of that test alone, the mechanism it was run for, and a reason when the pair was not run. Neither kind evidences that a test ran and passed.

reach_scope.description: Optional; only on a reach record. "test": each nominated test was run alone under coverage and its entry carries reached (a fact about that test). "suite": the whole suite was run once under coverage and each entry carries suite_reached, the lines the suite executed in the mechanism's file; per-test reach is undefined for such a run, so the record is information and never establishes reach. Absent on older reach records, which are per-test.
